description: The learning objectives of this course are: to get the knowledge of modelling software; to understand the 2D, 3D and assembly drawing features of different CAD software; and to understand and generate 2D entities using programming techniques. Software required: SOLIDWORKS/CATIA/Autodesk INVENTOR/PTC Creo; MATLAB.
experiments: To perform 2D scaling, reflection, rotation and translation transformations of a geometric entity.
To perform 3D scaling, reflection, rotation and translation transformations of a geometric entity and show its application for a unit cube.
To generate the top, front and side views of a truncated cube.
To generate isometric projection and apply it to view a given object.
To generate dimetric projection and apply it to view a given object in different orientations.
To perform single point perspective projection and use it to view a truncated cube.
To perform joining a set of points in space by Hermite curve segments and demonstrate the manipulation of curve shape by varying the geometric conditions.
To generate a Bezier curve for a given set of control points and demonstrate the manipulation of curve shape by varying the geometric conditions.
To generate a B-Spline curve for a given set of control points and demonstrate the manipulation of curve shape.
To generate and view a ruled surface between two given rails.
To generate and view a Bezier surface for a given mesh of control points.
outcomes: Draw the 2D, 3D drawing of complex machine components
Design contours and surfaces using modelling software.
